clips.title: The story
paras: At the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Maxan Anvol trains dwarven priests in the Holy Light. He tests young acolytes before they earn the Church’s vestments.

Maxan Anvol tends to the hamlet’s spiritual welfare from the Thunderbrew Distillery, where travelers, mountaineers, and acolytes gather. Kharanos lies between Coldridge Valley and Ironforge, and its inn draws those who pass through. Maxan offers prayers and counsel to anyone who enters, with pints of stout close at hand.

Maxan Anvol tests novice priests before they venture into the wider world. He has initiates use basic healing prayers on Dun Morogh’s wounded defenders. Those who show devotion and skill receive their first priestly vestments, marking their recognized place in the Church of the Holy Light.
